result.summary: The intersection features a wide one-way street with a marked zebra crosswalk and accessible curb ramps. However, the lack of traffic calming measures and the presence of parked cars near the crossing may compromise pedestrian visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the crosswalk can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway without a median or curb extensions increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of Callowhill St.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide better information to crossing pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane urban street with wide, well-maintained sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. The environment is dominated by vehicular infrastructure, with parked cars potentially obstructing sight lines for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at an intersection with traffic signals, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers near the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals in a high-density mixed-use area. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians without a central refuge.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a physical refuge island, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crosswalk spanning the wide roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.
